label: GO after unrewarded S2 visit, scaled by observer belief that S1 is good
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.clip(belief_lo, -3, 3) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is dominated by the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded (weight ~+1.8, the model-based stay-on-a1 case), graded up by the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief_lo). After a2 -> S2 common unrewarded it fires only when belief favours S1 (switch to a1), scaled by positive belief_lo. On window-first trials (unknown previous trial) a positive-belief term picks up some firing. Firing after a1 S2 u is smaller if the trial before also reached S2. Other previous-trial patterns (any rewarded trial, S1 unrewarded) give ~0. Observed-only, no model outputs or future variables; dev R^2 beyond timing 0.725 vs all-observed reference 0.77 and all ceiling 0.78, so dropping the model value/policy loses little: the last-trial pattern alone carries most of it (reference 0.72).

terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None)
(phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None)

issues: Large systematic miss on each window's first trial (prev_action == -1). The worst-fit dev windows are nearly all [-3] GO cells with actual 3.7-3.9 against predicted 0.33-0.39. The previous reward is observed at that trial's D1 even when the previous trial's choice and state are not, and the firing there follows that reward: it fires after prev_reward == 0. Adding (GO)*(prev_action==-1)*(prev_reward==0), the same term times clip(belief_lo,0,None), and the same term times belief_cover raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.718 to 0.805. That is above the reported 'all' ceiling of 0.78, so the label's 'a positive-belief term picks up some firing' badly understates this case.

The claim that firing after a1-S2-unrewarded 'grows with belief_lo' has almost no support. Dropping the a1 S2 u x clip(belief_lo) term changes test R^2 from 0.718 to 0.716 (0.805 to 0.803 in the improved set). Belief scaling matters mainly in the a2-S2-unrewarded case.
The tv('state',-2)==2 term adds only about 0.005 test R^2. The weight is real (-0.6) but minor.
The residual tables confirm the GO-only, a1 S2 u-dominant (+2.84) and a2 S2 u (+0.22) structure, and confirm that rewarded and S1-unrewarded trials give about zero. Those claims check out.
misses shows a uniform +0.09 bias at D1/D2 and -0.24 at GO for the other previous-trial patterns. This looks like an artifact of the shared intercept, not a missing pattern.
